verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents its own background automation: it automatically calculates, files and remits payroll taxes across states, and it automatically tracks employment-law changes and sends alerts. These are fixed, built-in automations rather than user-defined ones, and the APIs and webhooks are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, custom triggers and actions, agent-style autonomous task execution, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
